_comment: Was a STATIC (dispatched by nothing) wrapping an INJECT_TRIGGER whose inner effect was ACTIVATE -- not a real shape. 'Play your next <X> this turn AS THOUGH IT WERE AN INSTANT' grants instant TIMING to one card -- it skips the action-speed restriction rather than gaining an ability. Was a SET_FLAG nothing reads. GRANT_INSTANT_TIMING queues a one-shot, matched the way the other queues match and spent when the card is actually PLAYED: the legality path asks many times per decision and must not spend a grant merely by asking.
